title: rachel's banana bread
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease the bottom of a loaf pan.

directions.step: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and baking soda.
In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, cream the sugar and butter at medium speed for two minutes.
Beat in the bananas, eggs, yogurt, and vanilla for one minute at medium speed.

directions: Add the flour mixture to the stand mixer bowl and mix until just combined.

directions.step: Fold the walnuts into the batter with a spatula.

directions: Transfer the batter to your prepared loaf pan and bake for 50-60 minutes. A toothpick inserted into the middle of the loaf should pull out with some crumbs, not cleanly. Allow to cool to room temperature.
